name: Aerial Reconnaissance
description: Drones provide a perspective on a target that is impossible to obtain from street level. A single aerial pass can reveal roof access points, fence lines, security camera placement, loading dock activity, parking lot patterns, and guard patrol routes. This intelligence directly informs entry planning and evasion strategy. FAA Part 107 certification is required for commercial operations, and flight planning must account for controlled airspace and LAANC authorization. Always fly within the scope of the engagement authorization.

blue.det: Drone sighting by security personnel or cameras; unusual aircraft near facility perimeter.
blue.cm: Deploy drone detection systems; train security staff to report drone sightings; visual barriers for sensitive roof areas.
